statBlock.name: Elder Brain
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.classification: Large aberration (mind flayer), typically lawful evil
statBlock.description: The mind flayer colony tends this immense brain in a pool of psionically charged brine. It coordinates the colony by telepathy and feeds on other creatures’ brains.

sections.Languages: Understands Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon. It cannot speak. Telepathy 5 miles.
sections.Traits:
Creature Sense. Within 5 miles, the brain knows the distance, direction, and Intelligence score of every creature with Intelligence 4 or higher. This trait reveals no other information. Mind Blank, Nondetection, or similar magic shields the creature from this sense.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the brain fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The brain has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Telepathic Hub. Start and maintain telepathic conversations with up to ten creatures at once. The brain can let those creatures hear each other telepathically.
sections.Actions:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns while grappled this way. The brain can grapple up to four targets at once.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Choose any creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 18). No components are required.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
3/day. Modify Memory.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Bonus actions:
Psychic Link. Link with one incapacitated creature detected by Creature Sense. While linked, the brain perceives everything the target senses. When the target recovers from incapacitation, it notices the mental link. The target can use its action to make a DC 18 Charisma save, breaking the link and taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a success. The brain can end the link without an action at any time. It also ends when the two are more than 5 miles apart. The brain can maintain up to ten links at once.
Sense Thoughts. Choose a creature linked by Psychic Link. The brain learns its emotional state and most immediate thoughts, including its worries, loves, or hates.
sections.Legendary actions:
The brain has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use these actions only when able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Break Concentration (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. End its concentration on a spell it cast and deal 2 (1d4) psychic damage per level of that spell.
Psychic Pulse (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. The target and the brain’s enemies within 30 ft. of the target take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Sever Psychic Link (1 action). End the link with one linked creature within 120 ft. That creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.
Tentacle (2 actions). Make one Tentacle attack.
sections.Lair actions:
While in its lair, the brain can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using an option. It cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Force Wall. Cast Wall of Force.
Psionic Anchor. Choose a creature the brain can sense within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, its speed becomes 0 and it cannot teleport. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Psychic Inspiration. Choose a friendly creature the brain can sense within 120 ft. It gains advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw of its choice before the end of its next turn.
sections.Regional effects:
Use one or more of these effects around the lair. They end as soon as the brain dies.
Paranoia. Creatures within 5 miles feel they are being followed.
Psychic Whispers. A linked creature hears faint, unintelligible fragments of the brain’s thoughts and those of its other linked creatures.
Telepathic Eavesdropping. The brain can overhear telepathic conversations within 5 miles. When contact begins, its initiator makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a success, the initiator notices the eavesdropping without learning who is listening.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 120.

statBlock.name: Elder Oblex
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An oblex steals memories and uses them to imitate people. Its doubles can pass for their originals, apart from a faint sulfur smell.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The oblex can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. After taking fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The oblex does not need sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed automatically. On a failure, the target takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and is memory drained. A short or long rest, Greater Restoration, or Heal ends the drain. While drained, the target subtracts a d4 roll from each ability check and attack roll. Each further drain increases the die by one size through d6, d8, d10, d12, then d20. When the die reaches d20, the target falls unconscious for 1 hour, then the effect ends. The oblex learns all the drained creature’s languages and gains all its skill proficiencies.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 18). No components are required.
At will. Charm Person (cast at 5th level), Detect Thoughts.
3/day each. Dimension Door, Dominate Person, Hypnotic Pattern, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Sulfurous Impersonation. Form a double of a Medium or smaller creature whose memories the oblex stole. The double looks, sounds, and feels like the original but smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can imitate 2d6 + 1 different creatures. Each double is part of the oblex, which occupies both its own space and the double’s space. A strand up to 120 ft. long connects each double to the body. The strand is immune to damage. The strand severs if no opening at least 1 inch wide connects the double and the body. The double then disappears.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 199.

statBlock.name: Elder Tempest
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An immense serpent made of wind, cloud, and lightning. A storm travels with it, flooding the ground beneath its flight.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Air Form. The tempest can enter and stop in a hostile creature’s space. It can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attack.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the tempest fails a saving throw, it can succeed instead.
Living Storm. A storm 1d6 + 4 miles across stays centered on the tempest. Heavy rain or snow lightly obscures the area. Heavy rain puts out open flames and imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing. Strong winds throughout the storm impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls, put out open flames, and disperse fog.
Siege Monster. The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Thunderous Slam attacks.
Thunderous Slam. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) thunder damage.
Lightning Storm (Recharge 6). Each creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity save, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Legendary actions:
The tempest has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use these actions only when able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed.
Lightning Strike (2 actions). Strike a point on the ground anywhere under the storm. Each creature within 5 ft. of that point makes a DC 21 Dexterity save, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Screaming Gale (3 actions). Blast a 300-ft. line, 20 ft. wide. Objects in the line take 22 (4d10) thunder damage. Each creature in the line makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage and is thrown up to 60 ft. away from the line. Hitting an immovable object or another creature deals the thrown creature 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. traveled before impact. A creature struck by the thrown creature makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes the same impact damage and falls prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 121.

statBlock.name: Enchanter Wizard
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A wizard who influences minds, whether to prevent a fight or turn someone against their allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 14).
At will. Friends, Mage Hand, Message.
2/day each. Charm Person, Mage Armor, Hold Person, Invisibility, Suggestion, Tongues.
sections.Reactions: Instinctive Charm (Recharge 4–6). When a creature the wizard can see within 30 ft. makes an attack roll against the wizard, the attacker makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, the attacker redirects the roll to the nearest creature to itself, excluding itself and the wizard. The attacker chooses among tied creatures.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 261.

statBlock.name: Evoker Wizard
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A battle wizard who can direct an explosion through a group of enemies and spare selected allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) force damage.
Sculpted Explosion (Recharge 4–6). Choose cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. A magical explosion fills a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a point within 150 ft. The wizard can spare up to three creatures it can see in the area. Each remaining creature makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 40 (9d8) damage of the chosen type and knocks the creature prone. On a success, the creature takes half damage only.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 15).
At will. Light, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Ice Storm, Lightning Bolt, Mage Armor.
1/day. Wall of Ice.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 262.

statBlock.name: Female Steeder
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: This spiderlike Underdark hunter leaps onto prey and holds it with sticky legs. Duergar train female steeders as mounts.

sections.Traits:
Extraordinary Leap. Triple the distance of a long jump. Every foot of walking speed spent on that jump moves the steeder 3 ft.
Spider Climb. The steeder can climb difficult surfaces and move upside down on ceilings without making an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the target sticks to a leg and is grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can grapple only one creature at a time.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 231.

statBlock.name: Fire Elemental Myrmidon
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An elemental bound in plate armor, with no memory of its former life. It obeys its creator and strikes with a scimitar.

sections.Languages: Ignan and one language chosen by its creator.
sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. The myrmidon sheds bright light out to 20 ft. and dim light out to 40 ft.
Water Susceptibility. For every 5 ft. it moves through water at least 1 ft. deep, the myrmidon takes 2 (1d4) cold damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) force damage.
Fiery Strikes (Recharge 6). Use Multiattack. Each hit deals 7 (2d6) additional fire damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 123.
